newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telecom Argentina cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telecom Argentina cut.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said it downgraded its rating for Telecom Argentina SA to outperform from buy and reduced its estimates for the company.
-- "Following the recent visit with management, we concluded that strategy appears more conservative than" that of Telefonica de Argentina, the firm wrote in a Jan 10 report.
-- It reduced its estimate for 1997 earnings per share to $3.17 from $3.40 and the 1998 estimate to $3.60 from $3.74 to reflect lower fixed line connections.
-- "We are also reducing our price target for '97 from $54 to $50."
-- Telecom Argentina was up 1/2 to 43-1/2 in Monday trade.
